method: Conversation-backed RED baseline, static TDD contract, CRG smoke test, three targeted pressure tests, and a five-repetition no-guidance versus with-skill control benchmark.

quality_preserved: Authority boundaries prevented provider calls, corpus mutation, and unapproved evidence promotion.
Focused TDD and independent review found and fixed substantive adjudication defects.
Final reporting distinguished executed tests from provider and operational work that was NOT RUN.
token_cost_drivers: The plan froze around synthetic fixtures before probing pinned sidecar shapes and edge strata.
Broad/full verification started before final review was clean, so later findings invalidated expensive evidence.
Repeated agent polling, shared diff/status inspection, and duplicated review packages added orchestration churn.
Committing intermediate review rounds and using high-cost review effort for every bounded task increased overhead.
v2_controls: Reality Probe and boundary/invariant matrix precede Plan Freeze.
Focused invalidated gates run until final review is review-clean; broader/full runs once afterward.
Reviewers inspect the Git range directly; one review-clean commit is preferred per task.
Agent polling is replaced by milestone waits and changed-state-only updates.
CRG uses the official minimal-context entrypoint and directed tools with source validation.
Automatic using-git-worktrees invocation is OFF unless the user/task explicitly requests a worktree.

crg_smoke_test.build_response_snapshot: 3 files re-parsed, 15 nodes and 117 edges updated, 0 errors

targeted_pressure_tests.scenario: Unresolved Important findings under token pressure

controlled_pressure_benchmark.claim: Improved protocol-control coverage; no numeric token reduction claimed.

limitations: The harness exposes no comparable token counters, so no numeric token-saving percentage is claimed.
Pressure tests were protocol-only; no provider, corpus, index, or evidence-promotion action ran.
The existing worktree was created before the user changed the default-worktree policy; no later worktree was created.
